mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy stance becomes more accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 7.5% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 7.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand that triggers equity sell-offs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 20-day returns in at least 60% of cases, or the correlation with negative returns is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a stagflationary regime characterized by declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), corporate profit margins contract due to rising input costs and weak demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100 and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the prior two months signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through improved near-term growth expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST increases by at least 1% over the prior two months.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real rates rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: During a labor market recovery phase (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly), strong job creation supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal robust economic activity across consumer and business sectors, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through synchronized demand and supply expansion.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and INDPRO fails to produce positive 20-day returns in at least 60% of cases, or the correlation with positive returns is not statistically significant (p>0.05).
